asked: Please send these: What WhatsApp number should customers use to order? Please include the country code.; What is the shop's full address in Pune, and what are its opening days and hours; What are the return and exchange rules? For example, how many days customers have, and whether items must be unworn or have tags on.; For the products, size guide and customer reviews, which do you want.
questions_to_user.answer: WhatsApp for orders: +91 00000 11111. Shop phone: +91 00000 22222. Address: 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005. Timings: 11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday. Closed on Monday. Returns: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags. No returns on sale items. Products: Kurtas: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199. Sarees: Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999. Shirts: Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599. Dupattas: Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099. Size guide (chest in inches): XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42. Reviews: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D. Lookbook: 3 outfits built from the products above. Delivery: Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above 2,999, pay on delivery.

asked: Please send these: Which sizes does each item come in? For example, do all kurtas and shirts come in every size from XS to XXL, and are sarees and dupattas one size; Which of the products should show up as new arrivals.
questions_to_user.answer:
Sizes: Indigo block-print kurta: S to XXL. Mustard handloom kurta: S to XL. White chikankari kurta: XS to XL. Khadi cotton shirt: S to XXL. Linen-blend shirt: M to XXL. All sarees and dupattas are free size (one size).
New arrivals: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt.
